metadata.title: A homological approach to Dax invariants
metadata.abstract: We present a homological construction of Dax invariants in 4-manifolds that is intrinsic to the topological category and requires neither smoothing nor generic representatives. Applications include an extension of the invariant of Cha-Kim to neat disks without assuming local flatness, and a topological definition of the Dax map for arc spaces that yields a short alternative proof of the topological Dax isomorphism theorem.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 在四维流形中给出 Dax 不变量的同调构造，直接工作于拓扑范畴。
analysis.breakthrough: 不依赖光滑化或一般位置代表，将 Cha–Kim 不变量扩展到不预设局部平坦的 neat 圆盘，并给出拓扑 Dax 同构的简短证明。
analysis.limitations: 对象及比较仍在指定四维、圆盘与弧空间框架内；不应将无需局部平坦理解为任意奇异嵌入都已有同样分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
